name: M3_PMS100MI_HoldMO
description: Place manufacturing orders on short‑term or long‑term hold. A hold changes the manufacturing order status to a held state (short or long) so that normal processing is stopped until the order is released. Short‑term hold can include immediate rescheduling of the order and its lower‑level orders. Long‑term hold only marks the order as held; dates and rescheduling are handled separately, for example by moving a long‑term held order at a later time. Use the hold type to choose between short‑term and long‑term hold for the identified manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order to be held is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number for the item on the manufacturing order to be held.

inputParameters.name: MFNO
inputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number identifying the order to put on hold.

inputParameters.name: MOHS
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing order is placed on short-term or long-term hold. Enter 1 for short-term hold or 2 for long-term hold.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number where the manufacturing order is registered.

inputParameters.name: STDT
inputParameters.description: New planned start date of the manufacturing order when applying a short-term hold.

inputParameters.name: MSTI
inputParameters.description: New planned start time of the manufacturing order when applying a short-term hold.

inputParameters.name: FIDT
inputParameters.description: New planned finish date of the manufacturing order when applying a short-term hold.

inputParameters.name: MFTI
inputParameters.description: New planned finish time of the manufacturing order when applying a short-term hold.

inputParameters.name: RPLL
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether lower-level orders created through explosion should also be rescheduled with the manufacturing order.
